themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Spain, Italy, and Sweden are intensifying efforts to implement 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants for social benefits, housing, and public aid. This theme reflects a coordinated transnational strategy to reshape welfare systems along nationalist lines, with Vox in Spain and Fratelli d'Italia in Italy leading legislative pushes, while Sweden Democrats advocate for similar measures in local governance.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Advocates for 'national priority' in social welfare, opposing Malmö's funding for migrant-focused organizations like Flamman.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Proposes stricter immigration controls and prioritization of Norwegian citizens in social services.

This theme highlights the fragility of far-right governance models under pressure from both internal power struggles and public discontent.

This theme highlights the fragility of far-right unity despite shared nationalist agendas.

themes.title: Far-right reactions to Middle East conflicts
themes.blurb: Far-right parties and leaders are increasingly framing Middle East conflicts through the lens of national security, immigration, and cultural identity. This theme captures how far-right actors in the U.S., Europe, and Latin America are leveraging tensions in Israel, Iran, and Lebanon to advance anti-immigration policies, criticize mainstream foreign policy, and rally their bases around perceived threats to Western civilization.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's administration escalates tensions with Iran, appoints pro-Israel figures, and frames Middle East conflicts as existential threats to U.S. security.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei aligns Argentina with Israel and U.S. policies, criticizing Iran and supporting Trump's Middle East strategies.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni government supports Israel, opposes Iran, and frames Middle East conflicts as threats to European security and Christian identity.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS frames Middle East conflicts through the lens of Polish national security, criticizing Iran and supporting Israel.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: RN exploits Middle East tensions to advocate for stricter immigration controls and criticize Macron's foreign policy.
